mentions.name: DER structured data format implementation
mentions.description: A self-made implementation of DER, a structured data encoding format, which includes types beyond those used in X.509 and is already used for projects such as a game engine and other software needing a structured data format.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also made my own implementation of DER, which I already use for some things that are unrelated to X.509, such as a game engine, and some other stuff where a structured data format would be helpful.
